```{r}
module load tabix
bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\n' data/gatk.filtered.relaxed_studywide.bicolor.biallelic.vcf.gz > data/snp_positions.txt
shuf data/snp_positions.txt | head -n 50000 > data/selected_snps.txt
bcftools view -T data/selected_snps.txt -Ov -o data/gatk.filtered.relaxed_studywide.bicolor.biallelic.thinned50000.vcf.gz data/gatk.filtered.relaxed_studywide.bicolor.biallelic.vcf.gz
```
